履修条件
Graduate students who have an undergraduate-level background in science and engineering.
The students need to go to Busan, Korea in August 2026 to take this course.
授業概要
この科目を履修することにより、エネルギーや環境に関する科学技術分野の高度な知識を身につけることができます。
このコースは8つの高度なトピックで構成され、九州大学 (日本)、釜山大学校 (韓国)、上海交通大学 (中国)、マレーシア工科大学 (マレーシア) から8人の教授が講義を行います。
このコースは英語のみで行われます。
In this course, graduate students will learn advanced knowledge in the fields of energy and environmental science and technology.
This course is composed of eight advanced topics and will be given by eight professors from Kyushu University (Japan), Pusan National University (Korea), Shanghai Jiao Tong University (China), and University of Technology Malaysia (Malaysia).
This course will be given by English only.

全体の教育目標
The overall aim of this course is for students to learn about topical issues as well as advanced concepts in the fields of energy and environmental science and technology.
個別の教育目標
This course is specifically aimed at helping students to broaden their horizons and improve their ability to deeply understand and discuss research topics in the fields of energy and environmental science and engineering in an informative, engaging, and professional manner.
授業計画
This course will be given in the Summer School of CAMPUS Asia plus program (CA+), which will be held in the latter half of August 2026, in Pusan National University, Korea
This course is composed of eight advanced topics and will be given by eight professors from Kyushu University (Japan), Pusan National University (Korea), Shanghai Jiao Tong University (China), and University of Technology Malaysia (Malaysia).
The course details will be announced before the middle of August 2026.
This course will be given by English only.
キーワード
Energy, Environment, and Material Science and engineering
授業の進め方
Lectures will consist of PowerPoint presentations on the major topics. At the end of each lecture, the students need to take a 10-20-min test.
